name: obsidian-tasks
description: Run a project's work through the roadmap board in your Obsidian vault (a Kanban plugin board or a Bases board): take a ticket, keep its status, write the closing report, file follow-ups. Claude reaches the vault through its folder, the official Obsidian CLI or an Obsidian MCP server you set up; with session-board the ticket becomes the brief and Acceptance closes it.
